name: Doki x Doki Sasete!!
source:
Main heroine is selected out of 20,000 candidates to join an idol group of five boys "Astro Bomber". She receives singing and dancing lessons from the boys in order to perform together on a gig in a year's time.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-october-2001-jisatsu-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
女主角从20,000名候选人中脱颖而出，加入由五名男子组成的偶像团体“Astro Bomber”。她接受男孩们的歌唱和舞蹈课程，以便在一年后一起演出。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-october-2001-jisatsu-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
